lines.text: import { chromium, type Browser, type Page } from "playwright";
// A real pull request from an eval case, with the review a model wrote for it during an eval run.
// Strings, because scripts/ compiles without the DOM lib.
// Pierre paints diffs a few frames after the payload lands.
// Fail early when the saved review no longer parses under the current schema.
await rm(reposRoot, { recursive: true, force: true });
await rm(opts.outDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
const running = await startServer({ cwd: built.cwd, dataPath: built.dataPath, port: 0 });
await shoot({ browser, baseUrl: running.url, file, scene });

"summary": "Adds a five-context living-room night with seeds and page objects, adopts them across visual specs, and rewires the harness for snapshots and UI Mode. Loosens dependencies to ranges and ships an audit report, a QR fix, and mechanical renames.",

"why": "Single-surface goldens cannot catch pairing, presence, break mode, or cross-client sync bugs [bugs](source:s1). The goal is one scripted living-room night proving that contract [night](source:s1).",

"Issue [#98](source:s1) asks that living-room sleeps and races be called out in the PR. The [PR](source:s2) only checks the 10× flake box. The spec header documents the 12.5s TTL wait, playback touch, and heartbeat waits, and no source names why the PR omits them.",

"[PR](source:s2) says `pnpm test:e2e:ui` sets `E2E_UI=1` and skips webServer for an instant list. `package.json` runs plain `--ui` with no env and `playwright.config.ts` only skips on `E2E_HARNESS_ONLY=1`. UI Mode still starts `server.sh` with fresh Convex, and no source names why the skip went away.",

"The [commit](source:s3) says it pins Playwright to 1.62.1. `package.json` bumps to `^1.62.1` and loosens 30+ exact pins to `^` ranges. No source explains the broad loosening beyond the Playwright bump."
"summary": "Covers lobby through break, TV close, and finish in five contexts."
"summary": "Shares page objects across visual and living-room specs."
"summary": "Enables local runs with config, scripts, and docs."
"summary": "Loosens exact pins to ^ ranges with bumps."
"summary": "Stabilizes the QR hook in production code."
"title": "Multi-browser living-room E2E: host + remote + TV + 2 players",
"gist": "Full Playwright night with host, TV, two players, and Remote.",
"gist": "Implements #98 plus platform snapshot dirs and test:e2e:ui."
"label": "fix(e2e): stabilize host/TV QR readiness and pin Playwright 1.62.1"
"label": "refactor(e2e): introduce page objects for visual and living-room specs"
"label": "refactor(e2e): use page-object APIs in visual specs"
"why": "Introduces shared page objects for visual and living-room specs [specs](source:s5), enabling the groups that call them.",
"summary": "Surface pages like `HostPage` and `TvPage` wrap navigation and masks behind one API.",
"why": "Proves pairing, presence, break mode, and cross-client sync that single-surface goldens cannot [goldens](source:s1). Implements the requested living-room night [night](source:s2).",
"summary": "The `living-room.spec.ts` night uses `seedLivingRoom` and the `openHost`/`openTv` factory to drive five contexts.",

"note": "The night waits 12.5s past the 12s TV TTL then sends a pause command to force `getForHost` to recompute. Without the wait and touch, the host query keeps stale `tvConnected` and the remote shell stays visible. Reviewer decides whether the fixed sleep plus write is acceptable for the disconnect check."
"e2e/live/living-room.spec.ts": "Drives host, TV, Remote, Alex, Blair lobby to finish.",
"e2e/pages/living-room.ts": "Opens five contexts via surface page objects."
"why": "Uses the shared page-object APIs across visual specs [specs](source:s6).",
"summary": "Visual specs call `HostPage.open` instead of selectors and refresh three goldens.",
"why": "Provisions local Convex and Vite for the suite. Wires platform snapshots and UI Mode [Mode](source:s2).",

"note": "`server.sh` deletes `.env.local` on start and on exit via trap. A developer with their own `.env.local` overrides loses them when the webServer runs. Reviewer decides whether deleting local config outside test output is acceptable."
"why": "Bumps Playwright to 1.62.1 [1.62.1](source:s3) and loosens exact pins to ^ ranges.",
"summary": "Renames `test:visual` scripts to `test:e2e` and loosens exact pins to `^` ranges.",

"note": "A fresh install when Convex 1.43.1 exists installs 1.39.1 under the old exact pin and 1.43.1 under the new `^` range. The suite then runs against newer Convex helpers and TanStack code. Reviewer decides whether floating installs are acceptable in a PR about E2E."
"summary": "The `useQRCodeSVG` hook memoizes by primitive and ignores late resolves.",

"note": "`useQRCodeSVG` memoizes by primitive width, margin, and colors instead of the options object and ignores resolves after unmount. Host and TV QR surfaces re-render without regenerating SVG each time. Reviewer decides whether the production change belongs in a PR about E2E."
"why": "Ships the page-object audit report as a standalone document [document](source:s4).",
"why": "Holds the visual→e2e rename and platform snapshot move [move](source:s2) plus regenerated output, so risk stays visible.",
"summary": "Skip the `e2e.yml` rename, the 135 snapshot moves to `linux/`, and the regenerated `routeTree.gen.ts` – pure moves and output that mean the same.",

+

It builds the UI, serves the `cigster-99` eval case with the review in `scripts/ui-screenshots.review.json`, and writes 6 desktop and mobile shots to `fixtures/screenshots/` (gitignored). Pass `--out <dir>` to write them somewhere else. Use them for UI PR bodies and to compare a UI change before and after.
